summary: Retired BSF Commandant's dismissal after superannuation challenged; trial under BSF Act for NDPS Act offences held invalid without Central Government sanction under s.59(3); dismissal penalty inapplicable post-retirement; pension withholding illegal without specific order under s.48(1)(k)/(l); GSFC trial quashed; pensionary benefits restored.
legal_provisions_cited: Border Security Force Act, 1968 s.40, s.46, s.48, s.75
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; GSFC conviction set aside; pensionary benefits to be released within eight weeks.
